- [IRET.28.6.5.5] **`dslot` sync (RI-4).** Each time the backward-shift
  relocates a slot entry (`slots[gap] = slots[scan]`), it **must** update
  the moved dense entry's `dslot` to its new slot
  (`dslot[slots[gap]-1] = gap`) before clearing `slots[scan]`. Omitting
  this leaves `dslot` stale, violates the `slots ↔ dslot` bijection
  (RI-4), and causes a later `ds_oa_del` swap-remove repoint
  (`slots[dslot[d]] = d+1`) to corrupt the wrong slot. The `ds_oa_check` RI-4 assertion (`[IRET.28.15]`)
  gates against regression.
